summary: Robo.ai Inc. (the registrant) filed a Form 6-K to report its acquisition of 100% of Neurovia AI Limited from Aetheron AI Limited via its wholly owned subsidiary Roboai Investments L.L.C-FZ. Total consideration is US$100,000,000, payable in 149,097,957 Class B ordinary shares of Robo.ai. The shares are subject to an 8-year lock-up, with no release for the first four years, then released in five equal annual tranches starting from the fourth anniversary. Closing is expected on or before June 16, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The acquisition supports Robo.ai's technology development in AI robotics and intelligent hardware commercialization. Watch for regulatory approvals and the eventual share unlock schedule.
